data.name: Bion Clash
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Unruly Party Royale!

Bion Clash throws you into a vibrant, low-poly party royale where you'll compete in an ever-changing lineup of absurd minigames. Set in a comically dystopian sci-fi world, you'll navigate a society of sky-dwelling elites, industrious surface-dwellers, and outcast subterranean inhabitants. Inspired by the satirical humor of "Futurama," Bion Clash is designed for endless, chaotic fun and universal appeal.

Key Features

  • A new level of Chaos: Compete in a diverse and procedurally generated array of minigames, including frantic races, clever hide-and-seek, social deduction challenges, and family-friendly shooters. No two matches are ever the same!

  • Explore a Wacky Sci-Fi Universe: Jump into your terrestrial, aquatic, or aerial vehicle and explore a vast, multi-tiered world. Uncover new zones, social hubs, and secrets as you delve deeper into the game's narrative.

  • Rise Through the Ranks: Build your reputation and climb the social ladder. Use in-game currency to upgrade your character's stats and improve your performance in the minigames.

  • Free-to-Play, Fair-to-Play: "Bion Clash" is a free-to-play experience with a commitment to being non-pay-to-win. Our monetization is focused on a robust ecosystem of battle passes, extensive cosmetic items, and optional progression accelerators.

  • Play with Everyone, Everywhere: With its low-poly, cell-shaded art style, "Bion Clash" is designed for broad device compatibility and seamless cross-play across PC, consoles, and mobile.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon 590
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce 2060 RTX or AMD Radeon 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
